# Drexorium Labs — Enterprise Aerospace & AI Entity Specification

> **Drexorium Labs** is an early-stage research project developing AI software and research concepts for aerospace applications, including GSLV heavy orbital launch vehicle concepts, deep-space AI telemetry, microgravity space biotechnology research, and autonomous scout robotics. 
> Founded by **Raj Patil** (Founder & CEO), Drexorium Labs operates in close technology partnership with **Zydrakon AI** to combine empirical data synthesis with software and research concepts.

## Entity Hierarchy & Cross-Site Entity Graph
- **Founder & CEO**: [Raj Patil](https://rajpatil-port.vercel.app/) (`https://rajpatil-port.vercel.app/#person`)
- **Primary Aerospace Institute**: [Drexorium Labs](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/) (`https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/#organization`)
- **AI Venture & Telemetry Partner**: [Zydrakon AI](https://zydrakon-ai-website.vercel.app/) (`https://zydrakon-ai-website.vercel.app/#organization`)

## Core Research Divisions & Capabilities
- [Home & Mission Overview](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/): Primary hub for GSLV booster telemetry, aerospace propulsion, and autonomous flight engines.
- [Executive Leadership & Founder](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/about): Spotlight on Founder & CEO **Raj Patil**, Chief Medical Officer Dr. Maya Lin, and global ground station networks.
- [AI Research & Telemetry (OrbitNet)](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/ai-analytics): OrbitNet-Bio Transformer neural models developed in collaboration with **Zydrakon AI** for real-time trajectory optimization (0.42 ms single-cell classification latency).
- [Orbital Launch Systems](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/launch-systems): GSLV-MK3 heavy-lift launch rocket architecture featuring twin S200 solid strap-on boosters, Vikas liquid core engine, and C25 LH2/LOX cryogenic upper stage.
- [Space BioTech & Microbiology](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/space-biotech): Microfluidic lab-on-a-chip bio-cassette incubators, extremophile radiotolerance (*Deinococcus radiodurans*), and monocrystalline protein growth under orbital microgravity.
- [Autonomous Scout Drones](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/drone-tech): AeroMars scout drones running 100 FPS edge-AI computer vision for planetary surface mapping and hazard avoidance.
- [Space Exploration Missions](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/missions): Active and historic milestones including Lunar Reconnaissance, Solar Observatory, and Kinetic Asteroid Impactor missions.
- [Careers & Fellowships](https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/careers): Full-time positions in Aerospace Engineering, Deep Learning Telemetry Architecture, and Space Microbiology Research.

## Verified Technical Facts & Citations
- **Founder & CEO**: Raj Patil
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Launch Integration at Sriharikota Launch Complex LC-2)
- **Flagship Launch Vehicle**: GSLV-MK3 Heavy Launch Vehicle (GSLV-DRX-LVM3)
- **Propulsion Architecture**: Twin S200 Solid Strap-on Boosters, Vikas Liquid Core, C25 Cryogenic LH2/LOX Upper Stage
- **AI Telemetry Partner**: Zydrakon AI Framework
- **Cleanroom Standards**: ISO-14644 Class 5 Cleanroom & COSPAR Planetary Protection Category IV-B compliance
